To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of BBMB to complete the application. faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the BBMB Hindi Translator recruitment?
faq.answer: The last date to submit your online application for the BBMB Hindi Translator posts is 21 September 2026. Ensure you complete the process before this deadline to avoid any last-minute issues.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available for the Hindi Translator post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 9 vacancies announced for the Hindi Translator position by the Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB) in this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q3. What is the application mode for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The application for the BBMB Hindi Translator recruitment must be submitted through the online mode only. Candidates are advised to visit the official website for the application process.

faq.question: Q4. What is the official website of BBMB?
faq.answer: The official website of the Bhakra Beas Management Board (BBMB) is https://bbmb.gov.in/. You can find more information and updates regarding recruitment there.

faq.question: Q5. What is the advertisement number for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The advertisement number for this recruitment of Hindi Translator posts is 02/2026.

faq.question: Q6. When does the online application process start?
faq.answer: The online application process for the BBMB Hindi Translator recruitment begins on 31 August 2026.

faq.question: Q7. What is the job type for these positions?
faq.answer: The positions for Hindi Translator are regular government jobs offered by the Bhakra Beas Management Board.

faq.question: Q8. Where will the selected candidates be posted?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will be posted in Chandigarh, as indicated by the recruitment details for this position.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee mentioned for this recruitment?
faq.answer: As per the available information, no specific application fee has been mentioned in the official notification for this recruitment drive.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for the Hindi Translator post?
faq.answer: The selection process for the Hindi Translator post in BBMB is through Direct Recruitment, as stated in the official notification.
